extra.message: convertGradeExportToFormat interpolates the user-controlled reportType (and sourceCsvPath) into a shell command string executed via spawn("bash", ["-c", cmd]). reportType originates from formData.get("reportType") in exportGradesCsv (src/actions/admin.ts:392) with no validation, allowing command injection by any instructor/admin.

readCourseHandoutFile joins user-controlled folder and filename into a filesystem path with no traversal protection. Both values come from the downloadCourseHandout action (src/actions/files.ts:252-266), which only requires any authenticated user, allowing arbitrary file read (e.g. folder=../..).

cwe: CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

extra.message: readArchivedSubmissionFile derives baseDir from the user-controlled folder argument before applying a startsWith confinement check, so the check is ineffective: a folder of '../..' moves baseDir up to the project root and any file becomes readable. Reachable via downloadArchivedSubmission (src/actions/files.ts:276-301).

cwe: CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

extra.message: publishModulePage writes a file at join(courseDir, `${pageSlug}.html`) without sanitizing pageSlug (no basename(), unlike publishModulePreview at line 38). pageSlug comes from the publishModuleStaticPage action (src/actions/courses.ts:411) and can contain '../' to write arbitrary files outside the course cache directory.

cwe: CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

extra.message: saveCourseBannerImage builds the target path from the uploaded file's name (`${courseId}-${file.name}`) without sanitization. An instructor can supply a crafted file name containing '../' to write a file outside the course-banners directory (path traversal on write). Reachable via uploadCourseBanner (src/actions/courses.ts:656-670).

cwe: CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

extra.message: processAllocation uses decodeJwt (which does not verify the signature) and trusts the decoded role/cohortId claims. The partner cost-allocation endpoint (/api/partner/cost-allocation) and viewPartnerCostAllocation action rely on this, so an unauthenticated attacker can forge an assertion (role: sponsor/partner_admin) to obtain full seat breakdowns and enumerate cohorts. Note PARTNER_SECRET also defaults to an empty string.

cwe: CWE-347: Improper Verification of Cryptographic Signature

extra.message: viewCohortInsights grants elevated access to full grade-change history based solely on a client-supplied dataLevel flag ("elevated") without checking the caller's role. Any user who can teach the course (including a teaching assistant) can set dataLevel=elevated to retrieve gradeHistory records (who changed grades and why). Contrast with the fixed viewCourseInsights which derives access server-side.

importModuleStructure spreads the unvalidated, user-supplied lessonData object directly into the lessons insert (no Zod narrowing and no sanitizeHtml). Imported lesson content bypasses HTML sanitization and is later rendered via dangerouslySetInnerHTML in src/app/courses/[courseId]/modules/page.tsx:188, enabling stored XSS against students viewing the module.

cwe: CWE-79: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

extra.message: recordSupportTicketActivity logs user-controlled ticketId, studentName, and action without stripping newline/control characters. The action value comes from the request body at /api/support/ticket-activity (any authenticated user), allowing log injection/forgery (CWE-117). Contrast with recordGradeDisputeActivity which sanitizes.

cwe: CWE-117: Improper Output Neutralization for Logs

extra.message: buildSpotlightCorsHeaders reflects the request Origin back verbatim with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true (or '*' when absent). Any malicious site can make credentialed cross-origin requests to /api/catalog/spotlight-widget. Contrast with buildShowcaseCorsHeaders which uses an allowlist.

cwe: CWE-942: Permissive Cross-domain Policy with Untrusted Domains

extra.message: searchCourseCatalog returns the raw error message and stack trace to the caller when includeDiagnostics is true. The /api/catalog/lookup route enables this by merely setting the x-widget-diagnostics request header to '1' with no authentication, exposing internal error details/stack traces to unauthenticated clients.

cwe: CWE-209: Generation of Error Message Containing Sensitive Information

extra.message: The session JWT secret falls back to a hardcoded value "dev-secret-change-in-production-min-32-chars" when SESSION_SECRET is unset (same fallback in src/middleware.ts:6). If deployed without configuring the env var, anyone can forge valid session tokens for any user, including school_admin.

The exam-package encryption key falls back to a hardcoded value of 64 zero bytes ("0".repeat(64) hex) when EXAM_PACKAGE_KEY is unset. With this default, any attacker can decrypt answer-key packages and gradebook snapshots using the known key.

cwe: CWE-321: Use of Hard-coded Cryptographic Key

extra.message: The database connection string falls back to a hardcoded URL embedding credentials (postgres:postgres@localhost). If DATABASE_URL is unset in a deployed environment, the app connects using known default credentials.
